name: Cloudflare: pull Security Center insights
description: Every 6 hours, reads the account's active, non-dismissed Security Center insights (excluding configuration suggestions) and creates one pending alert per insight not seen before (source cloudflare-security-center).

params.label: Cloudflare account ID
params.help: 32-character account ID (dashboard: Account home > the account's menu > Copy account ID, or any zone's Overview page, API section).

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token (sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) with **Account > Security Center Insights > Read** (API name *Account Security Center Insights*) on this account.

setup:
## Cloudflare side
1. API token with **Account > Security Center Insights > Read** for this account. Store it as `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, allowed host `api.cloudflare.com`.
2. Security Insights scans run automatically (Free every 7 days, Pro/Business every 3 days, Enterprise daily); new insights appear after a scan.

## How it works
- `GET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/security-center/insights?dismissed=false&issue_type~neq=configuration_suggestion&per_page=500`.
- The endpoint has no time filter, so every run reads the current list and keeps insights with `status: active`; alerts are deduplicated on the insight `id`, so each insight raises one alert the first time it is seen (the first run back-fills what is active now).
- Title `Cloudflare Security Center: <issue class> on <subject>`; severity from the insight: Critical -> critical, Moderate -> medium, Low -> low; payload = the insight (`issue_type`, `issue_class`, `subject`, `resolve_text`, `resolve_link`, `payload.detection_method`...).
- To include configuration suggestions, remove `issue_type~neq=configuration_suggestion` from the URL; to drop low ones add `&severity~neq=low`.
- A non-200 answer or `success: false` fails the run with the HTTP status.

## Limits
- ponytail: one page per run (`per_page=500`, the loop's maximum); with more than 500 matching insights the rest are not read (narrow with `severity~neq` / `issue_type~neq`). Every active insight in the page is re-checked each run (an existing alert is returned, not duplicated).
- A resolved insight that becomes active again keeps its id, so it does not raise a second alert.

Docs: [Security Insights](https://developers.cloudflare.com/security/security-insights/), [How it works](https://developers.cloudflare.com/security/security-insights/how-it-works/), [Get insights API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/security_center/subresources/insights/methods/list/), [Token permissions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/).

config.expression: steps.pull.output.status == 200 and steps.pull.output.body is mapping and steps.pull.output.body.get('success') and steps.pull.output.body.get('result') is mapping

config.message: Cloudflare Security Center pull failed: HTTP {{ steps.pull.output.status }}

config.title: Cloudflare Security Center: {{ (loop.item.get('issue_class') or loop.item.get('issue_type') or 'insight') | replace('_', ' ') }} on {{ loop.item.get('subject') or 'account' }}
